content: vue-chartjs 5.3.3 (2025-11-03, npm). Official Chart.js Vue 3 wrapper. Exports <Line>,<Bar>,<Doughnut>,<Pie>,<PolarArea>,<Radar>,<Bubble>,<Scatter> + reusable BaseChart. Requires chart.js peer. Reactivity via :data/:options props with watcher re-render. Minimal wrapper, no theming. Not used in this codebase (PrimeVue Chart wraps chart.js already).
